notes: Source of truth for scripts/ops/check-artifact-retention-drift.mjs (live drift) and scripts/ops/apply-artifact-retention.mjs (plan/apply). The Firebase-default firebase-functions-cleanup policy (DELETE olderThan 24h) prunes every function image daily; a KEEP policy wins over a DELETE for the same image, so these two KEEP floors are what keep revision-pin rollback servable (Wave 1.5 drill 2026-09-23: both projects measured 0 servable previous revisions). keepCount keeps the newest versions of each function image (package), which protects N-1 when deploys are more than a week apart; newerThanSeconds keeps every version uploaded in the last 7 days. Both are floors: live may retain more (a higher keepCount, a longer window), never fewer, and neither may be scoped to a subset of images.
